Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: AcmeCloud wants to run a 46 week pilot (50k tokens/day) with a plan to move to production in Q3 if pilot metrics look good. Key procurement/questions you surfaced:

- Preferred commercial path: finance prefers a Purchase Order (PO) for production; pilot could run on company card if legal/security are comfortable.

- Security & compliance: Priya (security) will run our SOC2 and data handling questionnaire; Gagan (legal) will lead contract review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill drop a first draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners. (attached: MAP-AcmeCloud-v1.xlsx)
2) Camila will support a short security kickoff with Priya to scope questionnaire evidence (we can send SOC2, KMS details, and architecture diagram).
3) If you want to pilot on card while legal works on the PO, we can set up a short-term credit or pilot invoice.

Could you confirm that the stakeholders listed above are correct and whether a pilot-on-card is acceptable as short-term approach? If PO is required immediately, well prioritize the contract redlines and provide a procurement checklist for Finance.

Thanks 
